Twenty-year-old Himashree Boro, a tribal woman from Assam, went missing aboard the Vivek Express while en route to Guwahati on October 6. A bag was later recovered at Guwahati station, and her disappearance triggered a statewide search. Authorities have released CCTV footage showing a man approaching Boro shortly before she boarded the train.

Her body was subsequently found in Andhra Pradesh, ending the weeks‑long mystery surrounding her fate. The CCTV evidence has become a key focus for investigators probing the circumstances of her disappearance and possible foul play. The case underscores the importance of passenger safety and ongoing inter‑state coordination in missing‑person alerts.
